name: CONNECTS Validation Engine
desc: Voxel, target-informed neighbor-corrected, topology, and connected-component metrics comparing a moving/testing 3D binary mask against a ground-truth mask. The moving/testing mask may be an ome-zarr store, a parc (volumetric parcellation) NIfTI, a NIfTI binary mask, or a 3D TIFF stack; the ground-truth mask may be an ome-zarr store, a parc NIfTI, or a NIfTI binary mask.

foreground_labels.desc: Comma-separated integer label values treated as foreground when binarizing a parc/ome-zarr input. Empty means every nonzero voxel is foreground.

zarr_level.desc: Internal ome-zarr array/group path (multiscale resolution level) to read.

neighbor_rounds.desc: Number of face-neighbor dilation rounds used for the target-informed tolerance correction.

include_topology.desc: Include Betti number / Euler characteristic comparison.

inputs.desc: Moving/testing mask as an ome-zarr store (alternative to moving_parc).
Moving/testing mask as a volumetric parcellation NIfTI (alternative to moving_ome_zarr/moving_tif).
Moving/testing mask as a NIfTI binary mask (alternative to moving_ome_zarr/moving_parc/moving_tif).
Moving/testing mask as a 3D TIFF stack (alternative to moving_ome_zarr/moving_parc/moving_mask).
Ground-truth mask as an ome-zarr store (alternative to gt_parc).
Ground-truth mask as a volumetric parcellation NIfTI (alternative to gt_ome_zarr/gt_mask).
Ground-truth mask as a NIfTI binary mask (alternative to gt_ome_zarr/gt_parc).

outputs.desc: Voxel, neighbor-corrected, topology, and component evaluation metrics as JSON.
